name: Pompaia
summary: The late-autumn purifying procession for Zeus Meilichios — the Διὸς κῴδιον, the sheepskin of Zeus, carried with Hermes' caduceus to ward the city as the storm-month closes in.
testimonia: Suda / Photius s.v. Διὸς κῴδιον (the fleece and the purifying procession)
Parke (1977) 95–96 (linked in season to Zeus Maimaktes, not identical with a Maimakteria)
